saints.name: St. Alphonsus Rodríguez
saints.title: Religious
saints.shortBlurb: A widowed merchant who became a Jesuit doorkeeper and found sanctity in a humble office faithfully kept…
biography: Born at Segovia in Spain in 1532, Alphonsus inherited his father's cloth business, married, and raised a family, only to be left a widower after the successive deaths of his wife and children. Turning wholly to God, he sought entrance to the Society of Jesus and, lacking learning, was received as a lay brother.

For nearly half a century he served as porter, or doorkeeper, at the Jesuit college of Montesión on the island of Majorca, greeting every visitor as though greeting Christ himself. His hidden holiness and spiritual counsel drew many, among them the young St. Peter Claver, whom he urged to the missions of the New World. He died in 1617 and was canonized in 1888.
saints.knownFor: Sanctity in the humble office of doorkeeper.
